**Sacramental Glade** is a location in the Cranberry Bog region of Appalachia in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Once in a Blue Moon* update.

Formerly a pre-War park known as the Cranberry Glade, the area was occupied by a group of the Cult of the Mothman, who originally were in pursuit of an Ogua. When their Elder Adelaide encountered the trader Luca Costa, the group decided to ambush him and his trading caravan, taking all of his explosives and his Brahmin Moona Lisa. [1] 

Waves of Cultists spawn here during the public event Event: Beasts of Burden. They will not despawn if left alive when the event ends. The shacks and the barn are inaccessible, they only open during the event, and remain open for a short period afterward.

The main entrance is located in the south, with a large, inaccessible barn nearby. A few wooden walkways, some of them in disrepair, lead over the waters of the glade to three inaccessible shacks in the north. Many stairs and ramps can be found throughout the location, they lead to several elevated platforms, some of which have inaccessible shacks on them. Mothman Eggs are protected in one shack. A ritual space features an elevated coffin with a mutated bovine skull set on top of it.
